evals.prompt: 我想给现有后台建立一套能交给 AI 设计工具的产品功能材料。请用简洁清单说明 product-spec 支持的操作、各操作的作用、产品线目录里会有哪些文件，以及维护时不能违反的关键规则。
evals.expected_output: A concise Chinese overview of the product-spec structure, commands, generated files, and key guardrails, consistently naming the document 功能规格说明书.
expectations: The response explains that versioned V files record changes and CURRENT.md is the generated current snapshot for AI design tools.
The response names init, add, sync, check, and export and accurately summarizes what each command does.
The response states that only sync writes CURRENT.md and active V files are immutable.
The response says unresolved locators must be surfaced to the user instead of guessed.
The response says product specs describe functionality and interaction, while visual values belong in the design layer.
The response says outward-facing copy follows the project CLAUDE.md and written changes must be synced.
The response uses 功能规格说明书 as the exact name of the product documentation.
